# Barefoot Bestie Label

> A relaxed fashion label concept: dresses, sets, resort layers and small accessories that make getting dressed feel lighter.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Soft weekend pieces for sunlit plans and easy closets.
- [Shop](/shop): The Barefoot Bestie edit — browse collection categories.
- [Lookbook](/lookbook): Four repeatable warm-weather outfits.
- [Sizing & Care](/sizing-and-care): Choosing sizes and caring for relaxed pieces.
- [About](/about): The label's direction and point of view.
- [Contact](/contact): Ask about sizing, availability or the next drop.

## Collections

- [Easy Dresses](/dresses): Soft, unfussy dresses for warm days.
- [Matching Sets](/sets): Two-piece outfits that split apart.
- [Resort Wear](/resort-wear): Vacation-ready layers and lightweight staples.
- [Accessories](/accessories): Bags, scarves, belts and sun-ready details.

- [How to Build a Weekend Capsule](/journal/how-to-build-a-weekend-capsule): Choosing relaxed pieces that pack well and repeat easily.
- [Linen, Cotton and Gauze](/journal/linen-cotton-and-gauze-what-to-wear-when): A fabric guide for warm-weather pieces.
- [Easy vs. Sloppy](/journal/the-difference-between-easy-and-sloppy): Keeping relaxed clothes considered.
